name: Jim Schellinger
occupation: Sheridan County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Jim Schellinger is a Sheridan County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Nick Siddle, who is serving through the current term. Sheridan Media reported that Schellinger, Holly Jennings, and Christi Haswell were the three candidates elected to the commission in the November 2026 general election. No separate public-record account of his private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
